module.purpose: Provides SVG export orchestration for selected editor shapes, including bounds calculation, custom SVG rendering, foreign-object fallback rendering, embedded assets, fonts, masks, themes, and export synchronization.
module.summary: This module converts editor shape selections into React SVG JSX suitable for export. It computes export bounds with padding and container-aware behavior, prepares asynchronous shape and definition rendering, embeds fonts and asset URLs, preserves visual ordering, applies masks and theme colors, and exposes export timing through an export delay. Shapes with custom SVG serializers are rendered directly, while others use foreignObject-based HTML rendering protected by an error boundary.
module.businessContext: Supports exporting drawings and annotated visual documents as SVG. Failures can produce incorrect bounds, missing assets or fonts, broken clipping, or unusable exported artwork.
functions: getSvgJsx (~L31-119): Builds SVG export JSX and dimensions for selected editor shapes.
getExportDefaultBounds (~L136-183): Computes container-aware bounds and applies export padding.
SvgExport (~L185-472): Asynchronously renders SVG definitions, shapes, fonts, masks, and themed output.
ForeignObjectShape (~L474-525): Renders a shape's HTML representation inside an SVG foreignObject.

io: Focuses the export document body before rendering when possible.
network: Resolves image and video asset URLs through the editor asset resolver.
mutationOfArg: Expands and unions cloned or accumulated Box instances while calculating bounds.

units.name: getSvgJsx

detail.name: getSvgJsx
detail.signature: export function getSvgJsx(editor: Editor, ids: TLShapeId[], opts: TLImageExportOptions = {})
preconditions: editor provides a container document or the function throws before export construction.
ids is an array of shape identifiers.
opts, when provided, conforms to TLImageExportOptions.
postconditions: When export bounds are available, an SVG export representation is constructed with the selected shapes and resolved export options.
When no export bounds are available, the function returns undefined.
The export delay waits for the initial render effect before export completion proceeds.
invariants: Only shapes contained in the requested shape-and-descendant identifier set are rendered.
A single requested frame-like shape is passed as the single frame shape identifier; otherwise it is null.
Auto padding is enabled when opts.padding is not a number.
Dark mode resolves to either dark or light and is consistent with the resolved color mode.
Explicit bounds are cloned and are expanded by fixed padding only when padding is numeric.
Export dimensions are the resolved bounding-box width and height multiplied by scale.
edgeCases: If editor.getContainerDocument() returns a falsy value, the function throws Error('No document').
If ids is empty or the selected shapes produce no export bounds, the function returns undefined.
If opts.padding is omitted or non-numeric, default SVG padding is used and auto-trimming may be enabled.
If opts.padding is numeric, that value is applied as fixed padding and automatic trimming is disabled.
If opts.darkMode is undefined, the editor color mode is used; otherwise true resolves to dark and false resolves to light.
If editorDocument.body.focus is unavailable or throws, the focus failure is ignored.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Throws Error('No document') when the editor has no container document; other invalid or empty shape selections produce no export when no bounds are available.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: undefined when no export bounding box can be determined

stateMutations: Creates and advances local export-delay and initial-render synchronization state.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Produces an SVG JSX export representation configured with the resolved bounding box, scale, pixel ratio, background, preserveAspectRatio, color mode, rendering shapes, and optional single-frame shape identifier.
detail.summary: Builds the SVG JSX export for the requested shapes using the editor's rendering state and export options. It computes export bounds, applies scale, padding, background, color mode, and aspect-ratio settings, and returns no export when no bounds can be determined.

specLiterals.role: Thrown when the editor has no container document.
Default export scale when opts.scale is omitted.

specTests.then: The call throws an Error with message 'No document'.

specTests.when: getSvgJsx(editor, ids) is called without explicit bounds.
specTests.then: The function returns undefined and does not construct an SVG export.

specTests.when: getSvgJsx(editor, ids, { bounds, padding: 10, scale: 2 }) is called.
specTests.then: The export uses a clone of the bounds expanded by 10, with output dimensions equal to the expanded width and height multiplied by 2, and automatic trimming disabled.

units.name: getExportDefaultBounds

detail.name: getExportDefaultBounds
detail.returnType: { box: Box; paddingApplied: boolean } | { box: null; paddingApplied: false }
preconditions: editor provides shape masked-page bounds, shape lookup, and shape-utility lookup for the supplied rendering shape IDs.
padding is a numeric export padding value.
singleFrameShapeId is either a shape ID or null.
postconditions: Every rendering shape with usable masked page bounds contributes to the calculated bounds.
The returned box contains the relevant rendering-shape bounds, subject to export-container containment behavior.
Padding is applied only when bounds are not container-bounded and a single-frame export ID is not supplied.
If no rendering shape has usable masked page bounds, the result is { box: null, paddingApplied: false }.
invariants: Shapes without masked page bounds are ignored.
The accumulated bounds never exclude a processed shape's masked page bounds unless a containing export-bounds container replaces the accumulated bounds.
A shape is treated as an export-bounds container only when its shape utility reports that it is one.
A container replaces the accumulated bounds only when it approximately contains all bounds accumulated before it.
edgeCases: An empty rendering-shape list, or a list whose shapes all lack masked page bounds, returns null bounds with paddingApplied false.
When the first usable shape is an export-bounds container, its bounds become the initial bounds and the export is container-bounded.
When a later export-bounds container approximately contains the accumulated bounds, the accumulated bounds are replaced by the container bounds.
When a shape extends outside a previously selected container, container-bounded status is cleared and the bounds are expanded to include that shape.
A non-null singleFrameShapeId prevents padding from being applied.
Shapes with masked bounds that do not qualify as containers are incorporated by union with the accumulated bounds.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is defined for invalid editor or shape inputs; failures from the editor or shape utilities propagate.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns either { box: Box; paddingApplied: boolean } when at least one usable masked page bound exists, or { box: null; paddingApplied: false } when none exists.
detail.summary: Calculates the default export bounds for the supplied rendering shapes. It uses export-bounds containers when they contain the accumulated shapes, skips padding for single-frame or container-bounded exports, and returns no bounds when no shapes have usable masked page bounds.

specTests.then: The result has box equal to null and paddingApplied equal to false.
The returned bounds include the usable shapes and paddingApplied is false.
The accumulated bounds are replaced by a clone of the container bounds and the calculation remains container-bounded.

detail.name: SvgExport
detail.signature: function SvgExport({ editor, preserveAspectRatio, scale, pixelRatio, bbox, background, singleFrameShapeId, isDarkMode, colorMode, renderingShapes, onMount, waitUntil }: { editor: Editor; preserveAspectRatio?: string; scale: number; pixelRatio: number | null; bbox: Box; background: boolean; singleFrameShapeId: TLShapeId | null; isDarkMode: boolean; colorMode: 'light' | 'dark'; renderingShapes: TLRenderingShape[]; onMount(): void; waitUntil(promise: Promise<void>): void })
preconditions: editor provides the referenced shape, shape utility, theme, font, asset, and transform services.
bbox, scale, and renderingShapes describe a valid export region and shape set.
onMount and waitUntil are callable callbacks.
postconditions: Returns an SVG element configured with the requested dimensions, aspect-ratio behavior, direction, background, definitions, and rendered shape elements.
Rendered shape elements are ordered by z-index before being placed in the SVG.
Asynchronously loaded definitions are registered through the export state and waitUntil.
onMount is called after shapeElements has been populated.
invariants: The component is intended to render only once; a subsequent layout-effect execution throws an error.
Shapes are rendered in z-index order.
Duplicate export definition keys are not added more than once.
A single-frame export omits the selected frame shape itself.
Group shapes are omitted from the rendered shape elements.
edgeCases: An asset that does not exist or is neither an image nor a video resolves to null from resolveAssetUrl.
A shape with toSvg or toBackgroundSvg uses the corresponding custom SVG result; absent results produce no element for that channel.
A shape without custom SVG output is rendered through ForeignObjectShape, with an additional background element only when its utility has backgroundComponent.
A shape with a parent mask contributes a clipPath definition and applies that clip path to generated foreground and background groups.
When background is false, the SVG background is transparent.
When exporting a single frame with background enabled, a frame utility configured to show colors uses the frame color; otherwise the solid theme color is used.
If shapeElements is not yet ready, onMount is not called.
stateMutations: Internal export state atom: defsById and shapeElements.
waitUntil is notified for asynchronous export definitions and asset/font resolution.
The supplied onMount callback is invoked after rendering state becomes ready.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns an SVG React element with direction="ltr", width=bbox.width * scale, height=bbox.height * scale, the supplied preserveAspectRatio, theme-derived or transparent background, SVG defs for masks/fonts/export definitions, and shape content ordered by z-index.
detail.summary: Renders an SVG export for the supplied editor shapes, including custom SVG output, foreign-object fallbacks, masks, fonts, background styling, and asynchronously resolved definitions. It invokes onMount only after shape elements are ready.

specLiterals.value: SvgExport should only render once - do not use with react strict mode
specLiterals.role: Raised when the component's layout effect executes more than once.
SVG background value when background rendering is disabled.
Theme color key used to resolve a colored frame background.
Fallback theme color key for single-frame backgrounds.

specTests.then: The resulting SVG contains the produced elements ordered by ascending z-index.
The SVG includes a clipPath definition for the transformed mask and applies its URL to the corresponding rendered group.
onMount is not invoked until shapeElements becomes available.

detail.name: ForeignObjectShape
detail.signature: function ForeignObjectShape({ shape, util, className, component: Component, bbox, opacity }: { shape: TLShape; util: ShapeUtil; className?: string; component: ComponentType<{ shape: TLShape; util: ShapeUtil }>; bbox: Box; opacity: number })
preconditions: shape.id must identify a shape available to the editor.
editor.getShapePageTransform(shape.id) must return a non-null transform for normal rendering.
component must be a renderable component accepting shape and util props.
bbox must provide minX, minY, w, and h numeric values.
postconditions: Returns a React element containing a foreignObject positioned at bbox.minX and bbox.minY with bbox.w and bbox.h dimensions.
Rendering failures within the error boundary produce no fallback content.
invariants: The shape page transform is translated by the negated bounding-box minimum coordinates before being used for rendering.
The shape geometry width and height used by the component are each clamped to a minimum of 1.
The foreignObject dimensions use bbox.w and bbox.h directly rather than the clamped geometry dimensions.
edgeCases: When the shape geometry width is less than 1, the derived width is 1.
When the shape geometry height is less than 1, the derived height is 1.
When rendering throws inside the ErrorBoundary, the function renders null fallback content instead of propagating the rendering error.
If the editor cannot provide a page transform for the shape, the non-null assertion does not provide a runtime fallback.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit input validation is performed; invalid editor state or missing required values may fail during rendering.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: The ErrorBoundary fallback renders null for errors occurring within its protected subtree.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns a React JSX element rooted at <foreignObject> with x={bbox.minX}, y={bbox.minY}, width={bbox.w}, height={bbox.h}, and className="tl-shape-foreign-object tl-export-embed-styles".
detail.summary: Renders a shape's export representation inside an SVG foreignObject. It derives the shape transform and geometry from the editor and suppresses rendering errors through an error boundary.

specLiterals.role: CSS class contract applied to the exported foreignObject.
Minimum width and height used for shape geometry passed to rendering.

specTests.then: The component receives geometry-derived width and height values clamped to 1, while the foreignObject retains bbox.w and bbox.h for its SVG dimensions.
The error is handled by the boundary and the fallback renders null rather than displaying fallback content.
